title: Find Users with High Token Usage
summary: SQL: prompts(user_id,prompt,tokens), unique by user/prompt. For each user, count prompts and average their token counts. Keep users with at least three prompts and at least one token count strictly above their own unrounded average. Return user_id,prompt_count,avg_tokens, with the average rounded to two decimals. Sort average descending then user_id ascending.
officialConstraints: user_id and tokens are integers; prompt is text; primary key is (user_id,prompt).
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
